title: Test the Quest version reader edges: CRLF, duplicate or reversed markers, empty block, declaration after the end marker, quoted begin marker
description: Follow-up to WCLI-80 (ward-cli#175). scripts/read-quest-version.mjs is covered for partial versions, a declaration outside the block, and missing markers, but not for: CRLF line endings, duplicate markers, reversed markers (end before begin), an empty block, a declaration only after the end marker, and a begin marker quoted in prose above the real block. Add a test per edge and fix the reader where a case reads the wrong version or passes when it should fail by name.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each of the six edges has a test that pins the intended verdict
The reader fails by name, or reads the right version, in every case, and any behaviour change is shown by a test that fails before it
